_comment: TypeScript config for the UI, same shape as ~/fa/web and ~/RAG/web. Deno is the whole toolchain -- `deno task check` type-checks, `deno task build` emits the app.js bundle (install.sh runs both). src/ is the source of truth; app.js (and maptest.js, for the map dev harness) is a build artifact, gitignored.

tasks.build: deno bundle -q --platform browser -o app.js src/main.ts && deno bundle -q --platform browser -o maptest.js src/maptest.ts
